versions.changelog:
- Initial release of website-flow-monitor.
- Analyze website URLs to identify and categorize business-critical user flows (revenue, onboarding, product, trust, SEO, content).
- Propose a monitoring plan outlining URLs, expected behaviors, and impact categories.
- Require explicit user confirmation before scheduling recurring monitoring (cron jobs).
- Provide actionable status summaries, flagging issues (ALERT) for failed checks.
- Support updates to monitoring flows based on user feedback.
